extraction.text:
Madhukaran Akshay Kumar

+91-8019848425 | akshay.madhukaran@gmail.com | LinkedIn: akshay-madhukaran-b89489146

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Technical Product Owner with 10+ years of experience building and delivering data-driven B2B SaaS and US healthcare solutions. Specialized in data platforms (EDW, Databricks, Power BI), data mapping, and system integrations, with strong expertise in defining technical requirements and managing product backlogs. Experienced in working closely with engineering and data teams to deliver scalable solutions, optimize workflows, and enable analytics and reporting capabilities. Adept at prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and translating complex business requirements into robust technical deliverables.

CORE COMPETENCIES

✔Backlog Ownership & Prioritization

✔ Story Mapping & User Stories

✔ Product Vision & Roadmap Planning

✔ SAFe Agile & Scrum ✔ AI & Data-Driven Features

✔ B2B SaaS Product Management ✔ Data analysis

✔ Release Pipeline Management ✔ UI/UX Collaboration & Wireframing

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Persistent Systems Senior Product Owner Domain: US Healthcare / Clinical Trial Operations | Client: Fortrea

July 2025 – Present

Own product lifecycle for CTMS (Veeva) and Siebel platforms, defining product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization aligned with clinical and regulatory goals

Delivered self-service workflow enhancements reducing site activation turnaround time by ~30% • Managed and prioritized backlog across multiple product lines, balancing feature delivery, compliance, and technical debt

Led PI Planning, sprint reviews, and Agile ceremonies, improving delivery transparency and stakeholder alignment • Translated user pain points into product features, ensuring audit readiness and regulatory compliance • Presented product demos and roadmap updates to senior stakeholders across Clinical, Regulatory, and Quality teams

Bounteous x Accolite Senior Product Owner

Feb 2025 – June 2025

Domain: US Healthcare / Clinical Trial Operations | Client: Essenmed/Fortrea

Defined and maintained product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ecares 3.0, aligning with overall business goals and market opportunities.

Identified and prioritized features and enhancements based on market research, user feedback, data analysis, and business needs.

Authored comprehensive product documentation including user stories, use cases, FRDs, and specifications for 3 concurrent feature streams; acted as primary liaison across development, client, and stakeholder groups.

Collaborated with UI/UX designers to ensure intuitive, efficient, and visually appealing interfaces; provided structured feedback on mockups and prototypes against product requirements.

Managed backlog and sprint artefacts in Jira and Azure DevOps, applying Scrum best practices to ensure on-time, quality delivery.

Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure the product's user interface and user experience are intuitive, efficient, and visually appealing. Provide input and feedback on design mockups and prototypes, ensuring they align with product requirements and user needs.

FNF India Pvt Ltd Senior Business Analyst

Sept 2024 – Feb 2025

Domain: Title Insurance

Created and managed Epics, Features, and User Stories in Azure DevOps, ensuring clear definitions of acceptance criteria and comprehensive descriptions.

Authored detailed BRDs (Business Requirement Documents) and FRDs (Functional Requirement Documents), ensuring alignment with stakeholder goals.

Conducted gap analyses to compare current state ("as-is") versus target state ("to-be"), delivering actionable insights for process improvements.

Worked closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to define project requirements, review design documents, and confirm successful implementation.

Acted as a liaison between business units, technical analysts, and development teams, ensuring seamless communication and alignment of project goals.

Created mockups and wireframes using tools to visually represent project requirements. • Developed use case diagrams and activity diagrams with MS Visio and other relevant tools to support documentation and stakeholder understanding.

Provided recommendations on title insurance workflows leveraging knowledge of emerging technologies to enhance project outcomes.

Demonstrated ability to build trust and inspire confidence among business users and cross- functional teams.

RealPage India Pvt Ltd Business Analyst II Domain: Data Warehouse (EDW)

July 2021 – Sept 2024

Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business and data requirements. • Managed product lifecycle from kickoff to deployment, analyzing requirements to uncover gaps and opportunities. • Performed data analysis and profiling to identify gaps, abnormality and ensure high data quality. Facilitated discussions between business and technical teams to finalize mapping logic.

Worked closely with data engineering teams to integrate data from multiple source systems into the Enterprise Data Warehouse.

Identified manual, repetitive data processes and implemented automation solutions to improve efficiency and reduce errors.

Designed and developed interactive Power BI dashboards to provide actionable insights to stakeholders. Translated raw data into meaningful visualizations, enabling data-driven decision-making. Ensured dashboards were optimized for performance and usability.

Facilitated requirement gathering calls, stand-ups, and demo sessions with US-based stakeholders; proactively

identified and resolved cross-team dependencies to maintain delivery velocity.

Business Analyst Dell Technologies

Sept 2020 – July 2021

Domain: E-Commerce

Partnered with Solution Managers to capture release-specific business changes and translate them into prioritized user stories, process diagrams, and data flow models for Dell's global e-commerce platform.

Designed and maintained a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure end-to-end coverage; automated daily compliance reporting using VBA macros, eliminating manual effort and reducing reporting cycle from 2 hours to minutes.

Performed root cause analysis (RCA) on escalated production issues and worked with dev teams to ship fixes within SLA achieving 100% customer satisfaction scores across monitored quarters.

Amazon Business Operations Specialist

Oct 2017 – Sept 2019

Domain: E-Commerce | Focus: Automation, Localization, Data Modelling

Designed and implemented automation logic that contributed to a senior leadership goal of onboarding 50M+ ASINs to European marketplaces reducing manual catalog processing effort by over 60%.

Gathered and documented business requirements for account opening, lending, and trade finance implementation projects; facilitated scrum calls and managed testing cycles for cross-functional rollouts across UK, EU, and AU markets.

Built Tableau and Power Pivot dashboards to track product onboarding KPIs and localization quality metrics, enabling data-driven decisions for regional product managers.

Infosys Ltd Analyst

July 2015 – Jan 2017

Review the content and label the user listings by our user check, if they violate the guidelines regarding objectionable listings on the live map, we take an appropriate action. processes from AS-IS to TO-BE in an Agile environment.

Gathered requirements through structured stakeholder interviews; implemented risk mitigation procedures post Gap Analysis and coordinated with upstream/downstream SMEs to ensure feed delivery continuity.

CERTIFICATIONS

✔ Certified Scrum Master (CSM) — Scrum Alliance

✔ Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)

✔ Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) — Scrum

Alliance

✔ Agile Methodologies

SKILLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Product Management

Backlog Ownership, Road mapping, Story Mapping, Release Pipeline Management, PI Planning

Agile / Methodologies

SAFe Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement

Tools

Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Visio, Draw.io, TFS

Data & Reporting

Power BI, Databricks SQL, Tableau, Advanced Excel, Data Visualization

Domain Knowledge

B2B SaaS, Healthcare / Clinical Trials, E-Commerce, Data Warehouse, Title Insurance

Design

Wireframing, Mockups, UI/UX Collaboration, Figma

EDUCATION

Malla Reddy Institute of Engineering & Technology

(2011 – 2015)
